entities.name: The Eternal
entities.description: God of the monotheistic religion of Kush on Aerona, an omnipotent immortal creator, protector and destroyer.

entities.name: Kush
entities.description: Land on Aerona where the Eternal is worshipped.

entities.name: Muronian Order
entities.description: Order devoted to reminding the public about the fragility of everything.

entities.name: Ragalka
entities.description: Day on which the Eternal is said to return and destroy the world.

relations.note: Devoted to reminding the public of life's fragility, tied to the Eternal's coming destruction.
relations.quote: The Muronian Order devotes itself to reminding the public about the fragility of everything
